Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Record Class PerkBoost

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.PerkBoost
Record Components:
id - identifies the boost, for removing it
perk - the perk it boosts
amount - added to a number perk; ignored by a toggle
expiresAt - when it ends
source - who or what gave it, such as an administrator's name or a shop's ID
public record PerkBoost(@NotNull String id, @NotNull Perk perk, int amount, @NotNull Instant expiresAt, @NotNull String source) extends Record
A temporary perk boost given to one player, such as one extra host slot for 24 hours. A snapshot.

A Perk.Type.NUMBER boost adds amount to the player's value, on top of their tier; several boosts of one perk add up. A Perk.Type.TOGGLE boost allows the perk while it lasts. A boost ends on its own when it expires, on every server sharing the database.

Since:
1.9.0
